First release of `carve-go`, a pure-Go module for Carve that embeds the reference Rust engine as a WASI module and runs it with wazero. Consumers need no Rust toolchain, cgo, or build step.

### Included

- HTML rendering, static rendering, bundled Tier-3 extensions, AST parsing, document-version inspection, and migration reporting
- A sandboxed wasm runtime with bounded memory and no guest filesystem, clock, or network access
- Byte-identical rendering across all 892 mandatory corpus documents, plus AST node and schema-field coverage
- Reproducible engine provenance through the recorded carve-rs revision and committed wasm digest

The released wasm was rebuilt from carve-rs `1d788a73bf996b7af1974464f2f9bc92d7fb9b0c`, the current `main` revision at release preparation time.
